_source: Lost-Time Injury Frequency Rate, incidents and fatalities from OIL India BRSR FY 2022-23 / 2023-24 / 2024-25. Per million person-hours worked.
headlines_fy25: Best-ever LTIFR achieved in FY 2024-25 — workers at 0.071 vs 0.462 two years ago.
Highest number of near-miss reports filed to date — proactive hazard reporting culture growing.
Multiple operational installations earned 5-Star Work Environment ratings.
